notes.title: 0.0.3 | SHOP UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]0.0.3[/b]
[list]
[*] Added shop to Village Island
[*] Many items that were previously crafting are now in the shop and have been removed from the crafting list
[*] Now you start in a small island with only one tree
[*] Now you can sell Carrot, Wooden Board and Stone Brick
[*] Added Wooden Board and Stone Brick
[*] Changed the name of .exe file from "CatIsland" to "FarmingCat"
[*] Bug fix
[/list]

notes.title: 0.0.2 | New Update!
notes.content:
[b]0.0.2[/b]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42503796/b62272cad0e033e6278d54402645de31f0f38393.png[/img]
-Added first version of Village Island
-Added New World option to delete your current world and create a new one

[b]BUG FIX[/b]
-Fixed any bug that blocked the player in a looped animation and made it impossible to continue
-Fixed any bug that caused plants not to be harvested
-Fixed numerous save bugs[img]
